annotations.annotator: Assistant single visual review before new inference
caveats: Approximate logical-row boxes, not pixel-perfect ink polygons.
Boxes may overlap at ascenders; supervised pilot is annotation-conditional.
Masks on test pages are supplied by an operator; this is not an autonomous page-reading benchmark.

calibration.criterion: Minimum primary-width absolute count error on only predecessor leaves 1 and 2; ties choose smaller tolerance then no deskew. Calibration uses a count proxy, not geometric truth.

layout.grouping: Robust median local-baseline slope per paragraph, clipped to +/-0.15, then complete-link clustering of de-skewed baseline anchors within a multiple of median detected box height. No ground-truth row count or row box is an input.
layout.primary_metric: Micro one-to-one logical-row box F1 on leaf 4 at IoU >=0.5, with same approximate single-reviewer references for every variant.

ocr.input: Manual-reference box crops with paragraph masks; conditional recognition, not end-to-end predicted segmentation.
ocr.codec: One PUA code point per Boxer conventional glyph/group using pinned unicode_dict; space preserved. Unknown-marked units remain the map's unknown code.
ocr.model_selection: Only checkpoint after the final fixed epoch; one monitoring pass on training data at epoch 40. Test leaf 4 is never supplied to fit or model selection.
ocr.nearest_features: 64x16 standardized grayscale thumbnail plus fixed log-aspect penalty, Euclidean nearest neighbor; no test labels used.
ocr.metric: Micro Levenshtein error per PUA unit/space of Boxer notation (GCR); it is not language accuracy or meaning.
limitations: One training leaf and one test leaf in a small pilot; no claim of manuscript-wide generalization.
No external human verification of the assistant's crop alignment.
Unknown units can be unlearned; report test codec coverage separately.
